title.narrative: United Against Torture Action 1

description.narrative: FFPA agreed through negotiated procedure including 1st grant of EUR 8million, to a consortium of six international NGOs covering the whole world, including extensive reach into more than 100 countries through local partners and significant influence at international and regional levels. The United Against Torture consortium also has capacity and expertise in every area of anti-torture work as well as strong partnerships with other specialists. The project grant will implement movement-building and activities in all these areas, with an additional focus on the use of excessive force (including outside of the detention context).
